_comment: Client segments for The Monthly Close (see automation/EMAILS.md). One email is drafted per active segment per month. Jason: edit freely — set active:false to skip a segment, add locations to narrow local notes, or add segments (e.g., split a segment by city) and the next run picks them up.

segments.label: All small businesses
segments.audience: LLCs, S corps, and sole proprietors not covered by an industry segment. Broadly applicable deadlines and changes only.
segments.spotlight_guidance: Rotate seasonal fundamentals: estimates, books hygiene, entity housekeeping (Statement of Information), year-end planning windows.

segments.label: Restaurants & food service
segments.audience: Owner-operators of restaurants, cafes, and food-service businesses.
segments.spotlight_guidance: Tip reporting & FICA tip credit, 80/80 rule & POS tax mapping, dine-in vs to-go, local minimum wages (most exposed segment), seasonal staffing, Form 8027 season.

segments.label: Optometrists
segments.audience: Practice owners mixing exam revenue with frame/lens retail.
segments.spotlight_guidance: Sales tax on the retail side, equipment purchases & Section 179 timing, insurance reimbursement bookkeeping, health-care wage rules where applicable.

segments.label: Wholesalers & distributors
segments.spotlight_guidance: Resale certificates, CDTFA prepayment accounts, inventory costing & year-end counts, receivables timing, district rate changes that hit delivered sales.

segments.label: Service station operators
segments.spotlight_guidance: Fuel excise tax and CDTFA motor-fuels notices (rates typically adjust July 1), c-store sales mix taxability, environmental/compliance fees, supplier statement reconciliation.

segments.label: Lawyers & law firms
segments.spotlight_guidance: IOLTA/trust-account discipline, partner draws & K-1 season, PTET election windows, contingency-fee income timing.

segments.label: Grocery stores & markets
segments.spotlight_guidance: Taxable vs nontaxable item mapping, CRV changes, shrinkage & inventory, department payroll, EBT/WIC bookkeeping notes.
